CREATE FUNCTION CDN.CenaNetto (@Cena DECIMAL(18,4), @TwCID SMALLINT, @StawkaVat DECIMAL(5,2)) RETURNS DECIMAL(18,4) AS BEGIN
DECLARE @CzyBrutto SMALLINT
SELECT @CzyBrutto= CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(Naz_Nazwa,11,1)='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CDN.Nazwy WHERE Naz_GIDTyp = 64 AND Naz_GIDLp = @TwCID
RETURN (@Cena/(1+@CzyBrutto*@StawkaVat/100.00))
END

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.CenaBrutto (@Cena DECIMAL(18,4), @TwCID SMALLINT, @StawkaVat DECIMAL(5,2)) RETURNS DECIMAL(18,4) AS BEGIN
DECLARE @CzyNetto SMALLINT
SELECT @CzyNetto= CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(Naz_Nazwa,11,1)='N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CDN.Nazwy WHERE Naz_GIDTyp = 64 AND Naz_GIDLp = @TwCID
RETURN (@Cena*(1+@CzyNetto*@StawkaVat/100.00))
END

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.CenaUnettowiona ( @Cena DECIMAL(18, 4) , @FlagaNB VARCHAR(2) , @StawkaVat DECIMAL(5, 2) ) RETURNS DECIMAL(18, 4) AS BEGIN RETURN cast(CASE WHEN @FlagaNB = 'N' THEN @Cena ELSE @Cena * 100 / (100 + @StawkaVat) END AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) END
